notes.title: Player names on cards, Skip Pass nerfed, bugfixes...
notes.notes: [h1]Update 2.5.5 is live:[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45265589/83914db472b5eb400e7f8dc23334c4f0288ec88e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]What's new:[/h2][list][*][p]Added option to show player names on cards[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to show player name and position in rankings[/p][/*][*][p]Skip Pass costs 1 stamina[/p][/*][*][p]Stamina upgrade for Deluxe Locker Room is no longer duplicated[/p][/*][*][p]When upgrading card draw, show a hint above the draw icons[/p][/*][*][p]Scale down keyword descriptions if they cannot fit the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Show the correct card cost in draw and discard piles after a card was played with modified cost[/p][/*][*][p]Auto play only stops for mapped keys, ignoring Alt+Tab and similar[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed default DPI for scaled displays[/p][/*][*][p]Added display scaling option in settings[/p][/*][*][p]Added option to use the right mouse click on End Turn button[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed cut-off bug with certain screen resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Added hint that you can click the team name during match to see their deck[/p][/*][*][p]Mods can now load CSV files using cbLoadCSV(2)[/p][/*][*][p]Warn about missing mods when loading a saved game[/p][/*][*][p]Modded cards in Team Editor now load properly after restart[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text layout in some languages when you have no players in top 10 during halftime card choice[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The same changes are coming to Android version as well as soon as Play Store approves it.[/p][p][/p][p]Have fun playing![/p][p][/p]
